subject.title: fix(mattermost): truncate inbound preview on code-point boundary

question: Should maintainers require real Mattermost/runtime proof for this external log-only fix, or accept a proof override based on the production-path regression test?
rationale: The patch appears code-correct, but the external PR proof gate is not satisfied by tests and CI alone unless a maintainer explicitly overrides it.

options.title: Wait for real proof
options.body: Ask for redacted Mattermost verbose ingest logs, terminal output, or a standalone production-path run before merge.

options.title: Override proof gate
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the production-path regression test as sufficient because the behavior is log-only and low blast radius.

recommendation.title: Wait for real proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Mattermost verbose ingest logs, terminal output, or a standalone production-path run before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the best available owner because he is listed as a maintainer and authored both the current-main line/helper provenance and the PR-head test commit.
